evidence_quotes.O: This lens is beautifully sharp - absolutely no question as to it being an improvement of what was already a wonderful lens.
evidence_quotes.C: My primary goal is that of transcribing a videotape collection now several decades old to DVD for better archival storage and ease of transport when moving.
evidence_quotes.E: "$500 for a Blu-ray player?" my postal carrier asked as he delivered my Oppo BDP-103 earlier this month. But this is not your run-of-the-mill Blu-ray player, I said.
evidence_quotes.A: Later, I invited him in to listen and watch.
evidence_quotes.N: There were some minor glitches that were solved with the first firmware upgrade, already included on the release units.
